When the lanes get tough and the original Gremlin is a bit too "wild," the TOUR-X steps in to provide the control, predictability, and punch you need to stay at the top of the leaderboard.
We didn't just tweak the original; we re-engineered the DNA of the Gremlin series to favor control and versatility.
4000-Abralon® Finish: Sanded to a smooth 4000-grit, the TOUR-X offers a matte finish that reads the mid-lane early enough to be predictable, but late enough to retain maximum energy for the pocket.
The Bottom Line: If you loved the shape of the original Gremlin but want a more disciplined, "Tour-ready" version for league nights or tournament blocks, the Gremlin TOUR-X is your new go-to.
While the original Rondure MaxD Core was designed to push the limits of length and continuation, the Rondure TOUR-X Core was built for the surgeon on the lanes.
What does this mean for your game?
By bringing the weight closer to the center, the Tour-X Core generates a "professional-grade motion." It provides:
Predictable Mid-lane Read: No more guessing when the ball will pick up.
Controlled Medium Flare: A tighter, more manageable flare pattern that excels on tricky transitions.
Enhanced Accuracy: By smoothing out the backend "snap," this core offers a more continuous, predictable arc that keeps you in the pocket when the lanes get demanding.
If the MaxD was about raw power and length, the TOUR-X is about mastery and placement. It s the same legendary Rondure DNA, now tuned for the competitive "Tour" look.
V-R1 HYBRID: THE BEST OF BOTH WORLDS
To further refine this professional-grade motion, we ve finished the TOUR-X to a 4000-Abralon surface. This specific grit selection does two things:
Smooths the Peaks: It tames the "jumpy" response often seen on high-friction surfaces.
Maintains Energy: It provides enough teeth to read the mid-lane without burning up too early, ensuring the ball has plenty of "pop" left for the pins.
